patches.effect_on_numbers: none (the same root: the datasets the run attached = the stage's inputs)
patches.why: the decoded rfs_train.py looks up the extra feature blocks (RFS_CFG 'add', e.g. f_c5s / v_rl) with _xload, whose root is RFS_XDIRS or, when unset, the literal /kaggle/input (line 83 of the P / FACTOR-lab versions, line 96 of the 213 / 216 versions). Code decoded at run time is out of reach of the runner's /kaggle/input rewrite, so on Linux / Docker the lookup found nothing and on a Kaggle orchestration session it scanned every attachment of the session. Setting RFS_XDIRS in the stage text (which the runner rewrites to the stage's input view; the subprocess inherits os.environ) points it at exactly the stage's inputs on every machine; run as is on Kaggle it is the original default
